$comment: Card and sticker printers' file requirements (openspec add-print-house-images). Add a printer only from its own requirements page, with that page as source and the date you checked it. Sizes are the exact upload size in pixels, bleed included; the content guard and a core test check every entry against the format catalog.

printHouses.label: Board Games Maker
printHouses.notes: Upload one image per card face. Keep text and key art 36 px (0.12 in) inside the cut.

printHouses.label: MakePlayingCards
printHouses.notes: Premium card stock, custom finishes available. Upload PNG at 300 dpi.

printHouses.label: Sticker Mule
printHouses.notes: Vinyl stickers, kiss-cut or die-cut. Upload PNG at 300 dpi. No back side for stickers.
